items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is unknown. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown; data quality is yellow for analytics permissions or collector errors. Risk severity: high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, reject or defer new preview work, and continue only existing read-only security evidence work without credentials, permission changes, dependency additions, deployments, exploitation, or external outreach.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence work item only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work, access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Reject the proposed preview change requests for queue entry this cycle. Preserve them as deferred backlog until existing ownership, failure-repair, isolated validation, rollback, release, security, attribution, and measurement gates are documented. No implementation approval or deployment follows from this review.
